recipes.title: Pressure Cooker Pork Carnitas

items.i: white corn tortillas, guacamole, shredded cheese, cilantro and lime

steps: Wearing gloves, roughly chop the jalapeños, poblanos and serrano (seed them for less heat). Chop the onion and garlic and cube the pork.
Heat the oil in the pressure cooker over medium-high and brown the pork in small batches on all sides.
Return all the pork, then add the peppers, onion, garlic, coriander, cumin and beef broth and stir.
Lock the lid, bring up to pressure, then cook at steady medium pressure for 1 hour (about 45 minutes on high in an Instant Pot).
Release the pressure carefully, then serve as is or shred with two forks.
Pile into warm corn tortillas with guacamole, cheese, cilantro and lime, or use in burritos and enchiladas.
recipes.notes: Recipe is from the video; macros are estimated per serving of meat only. It's fairly spicy, so add or remove peppers to taste.
